overview_description.description: Z1 is a digital banking app made for teenagers and young adults where teenagers can learn financial independence. Founded in 2020 by João Pedro Thompson (ex-Vereda Educação), Thiago Achatz (ex-Grow Pay), Sophie Secaf (ex-BOX 1824) and Mateus Craveiro (ex-Pagar.me), the company has already conquered important investors: the Maya Capital fund and 99 founders , Ariel Lambrecht and Renato Freitas. Now, the company announces that it has received a contribution from the American accelerator Y Combinator, which has companies such as Airbnb, Twitch, and Rappi in its portfolio.

about_short_description.short_description: Z1 is a digital banking app made for teenagers and young adults where teenagers can learn financial independence.

product.name: NG.CASH Account
product.description: A digital bank account transitioned from Z1 to NG.CASH, allowing users to manage their money digitally with instant payments and transfers.

product.name: Z1 Reloadable Credit Card
product.description: A prepaid credit card where users set their own spending limit by reserving funds, with no risk of debt and monthly billing within the set limit.

product.name: Money Saving Feature (Guardar Dinheiro)
product.description: A function within the app that enables users to set aside money to reach financial goals.

product.name: Group Money Pooling (Compartilhe Planos)
product.description: A service that allows users to create groups to pool money with friends for shared financial goals or plans.

product.name: Mobile Phone Recharge
product.description: An in-app service that allows users to recharge their mobile phones directly from the app.

product.name: Gift Cards Purchase
product.description: An in-app feature that allows users to buy gift cards for games, streaming, food, transport, and stores.
